She notices the damaged grounds and checkpoints in the distance, but her focus is on the storm drain. As she approaches the storm drain, she sees that it's partially hidden by the damaged park infrastructure. She kneels down to get a closer look, her hand on the edge of the drain. She peers into the darkness of the storm drain, trying to see if there's anything unusual or any signs of Michelle's presence. "What am I looking for?" she whispers to herself, her voice barely audible.
